units.source_text: 大概注意到了灯光，女人回过头来。

en.t: Probably noticing the light, the woman turned around.

units.source_text: 她正熟练而灵活地用铁铲往石油桶里灌沙子。

en.t: She was skillfully and nimbly shoveling sand into the oil drums with an iron spade.

units.source_text: 对面，耸立着黑乎乎的沙壁，像要压倒下来似的。

en.t: Opposite them rose a dark wall of sand, as if it were about to come crashing down.

units.source_text: 那上面，就是白天寻找虫子时徘徊过的地方吧。

en.t: Up there must have been the place where he had wandered around looking for insects during the day.

units.source_text: 两个石油桶已经装得满满的，女人两手提着走了过来。

en.t: The two oil drums were already filled to the brim, and the woman came over carrying them in both hands.

units.source_text: 走过他身边时，她眼皮朝上翻了翻，鼻子里瓮声瓮气哼出一声“沙子呀……”。

en.t: As she passed beside him, she rolled her eyes upward and, in a muffled nasal voice, grunted, "Sand..."

units.source_text: 往里侧的路，就是挂梯子的那个地方，倒出石油桶里的沙子。

en.t: On the path toward the inner side, at the place where the ladder was hung, she emptied the sand from the oil drums.
She wiped off her sweat with a towel.

units.source_text: 周围，搬来的沙已经堆成老高一堆。

en.t: All around, the sand that had been carried in had already been piled very high.
